description.value:
A modified tech revolver with prototype cyberdeck-synced rounds. A bad omen for any who stray in its path.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Medium Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 2d6 • Capacity: 16 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Pistol Autosear, Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Incompatible with all Capacity modifying Attachments. Can only load custom NET-Linked Ammunition (50eb [Costly] per 10 rounds), which can only be used by this weapon. When using Autofire with this weapon, it expends 8 rounds instead of 10. If there are not 8 rounds left in the magazine, Autofire expends the entire magazine.

Whenever this weapon deals damage past a target’s armor, roll 2d6, or 3d6 if the Attack also incurred a random (e.g., not a Leg Aimed Shot) Critical Injury. Netrunners connected to this weapon via an Interface Plug/Personal Link may add their Interface Rank to this roll.The result of this roll determines the highest DV tier of Quickhack from which the user can select one of to inflict onto the target in addition to the attack’s usual damage (e.g., A roll of 9 means the user can select a single DV6 or DV8 Quickhack to apply). Applying the Quickhack does not require being a Netrunner and bypasses any Passwalls the target has.

####

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Pistol Autosear, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
